# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the newest release of each plugin in the default registry receives fixes. Update the plugin
from Settings → Plugins in ebookerr before reporting a problem.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. Report it privately with **Report a
vulnerability** on this repository's **Security** tab. Include the plugin id and version, the
ebookerr version, what an attacker could do, and the steps that show it. Leave passwords, API keys
and site sign-ins out of anything you send.

## Scope

The first-party plugins in this repository and the default plugin registry it publishes. A problem
in ebookerr itself belongs to the ebookerr repository's own policy.
